fields.title: Huddle
fields.description: A team fitness & accountability app that allows users join small groups ("huddles") around a shared goal, check in daily, and see group streaks and leaderboards.

fields.title: Kickoff
fields.description: Project kicked off, team assembled, initial scope agreed.

fields.title: MVP Complete
fields.description: Core auth + check-in loop complete, internal dogfooding begins.

fields.title: Private Beta
fields.description: Invite-only beta with 50 early testers.

fields.title: Public Launch
fields.description: Shipped v1.0 to the App Store and Play Store. 4.1k signups in the first week.

fields.title: Sprint 1 Planning
fields.description: Review backlog, commit to the Sprint 1 goal: ship the core auth + check-in loop.

fields.title: Sprint 1 Review & Retro
fields.description: Demo the check-in loop MVP. Retro: auth took longer than estimated, plan smaller stories next time.

fields.title: Sprint 2 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 2 goal: streaks, leaderboards, and check-in reminders.

fields.title: Sprint 2 Review & Retro
fields.description: Demo streaks + leaderboard. Retro scheduled for end of sprint.

fields.title: Sprint 3 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 3 goal: group features, notifications, beta feedback fixes.

fields.title: Sprint 3 Review & Retro
fields.description: Demoed group features and push notifications. Retro: beta feedback triage worked well; keep a weekly triage slot.

fields.title: Sprint 4 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 4 goal: let users create and join huddles, invite friends, and see a group check-in feed.

fields.title: Sprint 4 Review & Retro
fields.description: Demoed huddle creation, invites, and the group feed. Retro: invite flow needed more QA on Android.

fields.title: Sprint 5 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 5 goal: notification preferences, quiet hours, weekly summary email, and teammate nudges.

fields.title: Sprint 5 Review & Retro
fields.description: Demoed notification preferences and nudges. Retro: weekly summary email slipped a day on template review.

fields.title: Sprint 6 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 6 goal: crash reporting, API performance, accessibility fixes, and offline check-ins.

fields.title: Sprint 6 Review & Retro
fields.description: p95 check-in latency down to 140 ms; offline queue shipped. Retro: accessibility fixes should be continuous, not a one-off.

fields.title: Sprint 7 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 7 goal: store listings, privacy/account deletion, social login, and load testing. Feature freeze 9/14.

fields.title: Sprint 7 Review & Retro
fields.description: Feature freeze held. Store assets submitted. Retro: social login took longer due to Apple review requirements.

fields.title: Sprint 8 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 8 goal: ship v1.0 to the App Store and Play Store on 10/1 and stabilize with fast hotfixes.

fields.title: Sprint 8 Review & Retro
fields.description: v1.0 launched 10/1; two hotfixes shipped within 48 hours. Retro: add a device/timezone test matrix to release QA.

fields.title: Sprint 9 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 9 goal: act on launch feedback: onboarding drop-off, group chat reactions, retention funnel.

fields.title: Sprint 9 Review & Retro
fields.description: Onboarding completion up from 62% to 81%. Retention funnel live.

fields.title: Sprint 10 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 10 goal: improve week-2 retention with streak recovery, recap sharing, and polish.

fields.title: Sprint 10 Review & Retro
fields.description: Sprint 10 demo and retrospective.

fields.title: Sprint 11 Planning
fields.description: Commit to Sprint 11 goal: huddle challenges and health-app sync for the v1.1 release on 11/23.

fields.title: Feature Freeze
fields.description: No new features after this date — only launch-blocking fixes.

fields.title: Release Candidate Submitted
fields.description: v1.0 RC submitted to App Store and Play Store review.

fields.title: Store Approval
fields.description: Both stores approved v1.0; launch scheduled for 10/1.

fields.title: Launch Retrospective
fields.description: Whole-team retro on launch week. Notes on the Management Board.

fields.title: 5,000 Users
fields.description: Crossed 5,000 registered users and 600 active huddles.

fields.title: v1.1 Release
fields.description: Streak recovery, huddle challenges, and health-app sync.

fields.title: Meeting
fields.description: Next meeting is on 10/29 at 8am.

fields.title: App Store / Play Store listing assets
fields.description: Screenshots, preview video, descriptions, and keywords for both stores.

fields.title: Privacy policy & account deletion
fields.description: Publish privacy policy and add in-app account + data deletion (store requirement).

fields.title: Load test leaderboard endpoints
fields.description: Simulate 10k concurrent users against leaderboard and feed endpoints.

fields.title: Launch-day monitoring dashboard
fields.description: Single dashboard for signups, check-ins, crash rate, and API errors on launch day.

fields.title: Hotfix: reminders firing in wrong timezone
fields.description: Reminders used server time for users who travelled; use device timezone.

fields.title: Hotfix: invite links failing on Android
fields.description: Deep links from invite codes opened the browser instead of the app on Android 14.

fields.title: Product analytics events
fields.description: Instrument signup, first check-in, huddle join, and nudge events.

fields.title: Onboarding drop-off fix: skippable profile step
fields.description: 38% of new users quit on the profile step; make it optional and defer it.

fields.title: Retention funnel dashboard
fields.description: Day-1 / day-7 / day-30 retention by signup cohort.

fields.title: Streak recovery challenge
fields.description: After a broken streak, offer a 3-day challenge that restores it.

fields.title: Dark mode
fields.description: System-aware dark theme across all screens.

fields.title: Fix: leaderboard tie ordering
fields.description: Members tied on streak length should be ordered by most recent check-in.

fields.title: Beta retro — 8/3
fields.description: Beta testers loved streaks; top asks were group feed and invites. Reminders felt spammy — add quiet hours.

fields.title: Launch go/no-go — 9/29
fields.description: Store approvals in. Crash-free sessions 99.6% on RC. Decision: GO for 10/1.

fields.title: Launch retro — 10/14
fields.description: Launch went well: 4.1k signups in week one. Timezone reminder bug and Android invite links were the big misses — add device-matrix testing to the release checklist.

fields.title: Q4 planning — 10/21
fields.description: Focus for the rest of Q4 is week-2 retention. v1.1 target 11/23: streak recovery, huddle challenges, health sync.

fields.title: Review weekly store analytics
fields.description: Ratings, reviews, and install conversion — post highlights in the team channel.

fields.title: Approve v1.1 scope
fields.description: Sign off on the Sprint 11 backlog before planning on 11/9.

fields.text: On-call rota staffed for launch week

fields.content: As a user, I want to log in with Google or Apple so that I do not need to create a new password.
As a user, I want reminders at a time I choose so that check-ins fit my schedule.
As a user, I want to see a streak-freeze warning so that I do not lose my streak accidentally.
As a huddle member, I want to see my group's check-ins in one feed so that I feel accountable to them.
As a huddle member, I want to nudge a teammate who hasn't checked in so that our group keeps its streak.
As a user with spotty signal, I want my check-in saved offline so that I don't lose my streak.
As a new user, I want to skip filling out my profile so that I can join my huddle right away.
As a user who just lost a streak, I want a way to earn it back so that I don't give up on the app.
